description: This file defines a React component for a context menu, including related subcomponents and hooks for handling positioning, theme, and interaction with notes and categories within a note-taking application.

classes.name: ContextMenu
classes.description: Main React functional component for rendering a context menu with positioning and theme support.

classes.name: CategoryMenu
classes.description: Subcomponent for rendering category-specific menu options.

classes.name: NotesMenu
classes.description: Subcomponent for rendering note-specific menu options, including category assignment.

methods.name: getOptionsYPosition
methods.description: Calculates the Y position for the context menu to ensure it stays within viewport bounds.

methods.name: _addCategoryToNote
methods.description: Dispatches action to add a category to a note.

methods.name: _updateActiveNote
methods.description: Dispatches action to update the active note.

methods.name: _updateActiveCategoryId
methods.description: Dispatches action to update the active category ID.
